notes: Author-proposed material claim map, not independent acceptance. Synthetic examples are illustrative. Verify whole-page coverage independently; add omitted material claims. Raw primary-source snapshots/catalog live in .agent/session228/rebasing-full-send/sources/. Git practice is local Git 2.56.0, not Kubernetes execution.

claims.claim_text: Commit identifiers include tree, parents, author/committer and message; rewording an ancestor changes descendant identifiers.
claims.span_hint: The Philosophy of History Rewriting
claims.rationale: Commit object description; Rewriting History explains the descendant cascade.

claims.claim_text: Coordinate rewriting commits others depend on; merge or revert preserves shared history.
claims.span_hint: Golden Rule; Patterns and Decision Framework; Quiz 5
claims.rationale: Published-history warnings; rebase recovering-from-upstream section documents downstream disruption.

claims.claim_text: Diverged two-branch merges normally create a two-parent commit; fast-forward moves the pointer without a new commit.
claims.span_hint: Merging, Rebasing, and the Shape of Review
claims.rationale: FAST-FORWARD MERGE and TRUE MERGE sections.

claims.claim_text: Rebase selects branch work and replays it in order on a new base, stopping at conflicts.
claims.span_hint: Merging, Rebasing; conflict prediction; replay diagram
claims.rationale: DESCRIPTION gives replay and conflict resolution sequence.

claims.claim_text: Interactive rebase edits an oldest-first instruction sheet; HEAD~5 selects the latest five commits in the linear example.
claims.span_hint: The Interactive Rebase Interface
claims.rationale: INTERACTIVE MODE contains the five-commit reorder example; book explains order.

claims.claim_text: Pick replays a change; its identifier may change; reword changes the message.
claims.span_hint: Command table and SHA prediction/card A
claims.rationale: Interactive rebase and message modification sections.

claims.claim_text: Squash combines commits and offers messages; plain fixup combines changes while discarding the lower message.
claims.span_hint: Command table; Crafting a Reviewable Pull Request; Quiz 1/3; lab
claims.rationale: INTERACTIVE MODE explains squash, fixup and message handling.

claims.claim_text: Edit pauses after applying the commit; amend or reset and recommit pieces before continuing.
claims.span_hint: Surgical Edits, Splits; Quiz 4
claims.rationale: SPLITTING COMMITS gives edit, mixed reset, add, commit, continue.

claims.claim_text: Default mixed reset HEAD~1 moves HEAD and resets the index while leaving worktree changes.
claims.span_hint: Surgical Edits reset fence; Quiz 4
claims.rationale: DESCRIPTION --mixed default and undo-a-commit example.

claims.claim_text: Drop or deletion of a todo line omits that commit from the rewritten branch.
claims.span_hint: Command table; anti-patterns; Common Mistakes
claims.rationale: Deleting a commit section.

claims.claim_text: Exec runs shell checks and a nonzero command stops the rebase.
claims.span_hint: Command table; Patterns; Did You Know
claims.rationale: --exec and INTERACTIVE MODE testing examples.

claims.claim_text: Resolve conflicting files, stage, then rebase --continue; ordinary conflict recovery need not create a separate manual commit.
claims.span_hint: Surgical Edits, conflict output; Quiz 2; card B
claims.rationale: DESCRIPTION conflict handling uses add and continue.

claims.claim_text: Abort resets the in-progress rebase back to its original branch state in the clean-start workflow.
claims.span_hint: Abort fence; Quiz 7; Common Mistakes
claims.rationale: MODE OPTIONS distinguishes abort from quit.

claims.claim_text: Rerere records conflict resolutions and can reuse them; inspect reused results rather than assume semantic correctness.
claims.span_hint: Surgical Edits; Common Mistakes
claims.rationale: DESCRIPTION explains recorded resolutions; config rerere.enabled activates recording.

claims.claim_text: Rebase --onto new-base old-upstream branch moves branch commits outside old-upstream onto new-base in this linear example.
claims.span_hint: Transplanting Work; Quiz 6; Decision Framework
claims.rationale: TopicA/topicB transplant diagram and upstream boundary.

claims.claim_text: Squash merging a base does not retain its individual commit identities, so dependent work needs a verified old boundary.
claims.span_hint: Transplanting Work scenario and diagram; Quiz 6
claims.rationale: Squash section; Git rebase recovering-from-upstream explains hard-case boundaries.

claims.claim_text: Rewriting surviving history does not erase copied credentials; revoke/rotate exposed credentials and coordinate cleanup.
claims.span_hint: Why Matters; Crafting; Patterns; Quiz 3; card D; lab
claims.rationale: About removing sensitive data and side effects include rotation, clones, caches and changed commit hashes.

claims.claim_text: Fixing up the later removal into the addition removes the fake value from surviving commits, not all refs, reflogs or object storage.
claims.span_hint: Crafting; Quiz 1/3; six-commit lab success criteria
claims.rationale: Fixup semantics plus actual extracted six-commit exercise run; reflog/source exposure limits are explicit.

claims.claim_text: Git 1.7.4 introduced git commit --fixup and --squash options.
claims.span_hint: Did You Know fact 1
claims.rationale: Release notes Updates since v1.7.3, git commit bullet.

claims.claim_text: Reflog expiration defaults are 90 days ordinary and 30 days unreachable; configuration/pruning can shorten recovery.
claims.span_hint: Did You Know fact 2; old-object replay diagram
claims.rationale: --expire and --expire-unreachable; expiration is not an object-retention guarantee.

claims.claim_text: Linux patch submission asks for separate logical changes and buildable intermediate patches for review/bisect.
claims.span_hint: Did You Know fact 3; buildability rationale
claims.rationale: Separate your changes section.

claims.claim_text: ConfigMaps are for non-confidential configuration; actual secrets require appropriate Secret handling; Deployment probes are workload configuration.
claims.span_hint: Hypothetical Kubernetes context; Crafting a Reviewable PR; Sources
claims.rationale: ConfigMap caution plus Secrets and probe primary docs; lab explicitly incomplete and Git-only.
